title: Connecting ideas
focus: Written connectors in short passages: 因为 所以 但是 可是 如果 然后 还是 或者 虽然 已经 一直.
body:
# Connecting ideas

Once sentences get longer, the connecting words carry the meaning: because, so, but, if, then. You use all of these in speech already. In writing they often come in pairs (因为...所以, 虽然...但是), so spotting the first one tells you what the second half will do.

| Pair or word | Pinyin | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 因为...所以 | yīnwèi... suǒyǐ | because... so |
| 虽然...但是/可是 | suīrán... dànshì / kěshì | although... (but) |
| 如果/要是...就 | rúguǒ / yàoshi... jiù | if... then |
| 先...然后...最后 | xiān... ránhòu... zuìhòu | first... then... finally |
| 还是 / 或者 | háishi / huòzhě | or (question) / or (statement) |
| 不但...而且 | búdàn... érqiě | not only... but also |
| 已经 / 一直 | yǐjīng / yìzhí | already / all along |

## Examples

- 因为太累了,所以早睡了。 yīnwèi tài lèi le, suǒyǐ zǎo shuì le: I was so tired, so I went to bed early.
- 虽然很难,但是很有意思。 suīrán hěn nán, dànshì hěn yǒu yìsi: It's hard, but it's interesting.
- 如果明天不下雨,我们就去。 rúguǒ míngtiān bú xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù qù: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we'll go.
- 先吃饭,然后去看电影。 xiān chīfàn, ránhòu qù kàn diànyǐng: Eat first, then go to the movies.
- 你喝茶还是咖啡? nǐ hē chá háishi kāfēi: Do you want tea or coffee?
- 明天或者后天都行。 míngtiān huòzhě hòutiān dōu xíng: Tomorrow or the day after both work.
- 他已经走了。 tā yǐjīng zǒu le: He's already left.
- 我一直想去中国。 wǒ yìzhí xiǎng qù Zhōngguó: I've always wanted to go to China.
- 不错,不过有点贵。 búcuò, búguò yǒudiǎn guì: Not bad, but a bit pricey.
- 其实我不想去。 qíshí wǒ bù xiǎng qù: Actually, I don't want to go.
- 他一边吃饭一边看手机。 tā yìbiān chīfàn yìbiān kàn shǒujī: He looks at his phone while he eats.

## Common mistakes

- **已 vs 己 vs 巳.** 已 (yǐ, already, in 已经) has the stroke closed halfway; 己 (jǐ, self, in 自己) is open; 巳 (sì) is fully closed.
- **还 has two readings.** It's hái in 还是 and 还有, but huán (give back) in 还钱.
- **还是 vs 或者.** Both mean "or", but 还是 asks a question and 或者 states options.

cards.Example: 因为下雨,我没去。 yīnwèi xià yǔ, wǒ méi qù: I didn't go because it rained.
cards.Notes: 因 = 囗 enclosure + 大; 为 is wèi here

cards.Example: 我病了,所以没来。 wǒ bìng le, suǒyǐ méi lái: I was sick, so I didn't come.
cards.Notes: 所 is the same as in 厕所; 以 = yǐ

cards.Example: 我想去,但是没时间。 wǒ xiǎng qù, dànshì méi shíjiān: I want to go, but I don't have time.
cards.Notes: 但 = 亻 + 旦 dàn for the sound

cards.Example: 好吃是好吃,可是太贵了。 hǎochī shì hǎochī, kěshì tài guì le: It's tasty, sure, but way too expensive.
cards.Notes: 可 is also in 可以 and 可爱

cards.Example: 如果你有空,就来吧。 rúguǒ nǐ yǒu kòng, jiù lái ba: If you're free, come over.
cards.Notes: 如 = 女 + 口; 果 is fruit, as in 水果

cards.Example: 先吃饭,然后去看电影。 xiān chīfàn, ránhòu qù kàn diànyǐng: Eat first, then go to the movies.
cards.Notes: 然 has 灬 fire dots at the bottom

cards.Example: 你喝茶还是咖啡? nǐ hē chá háishi kāfēi: Tea or coffee?
cards.Notes: 还 is hái here, but huán (return) in 还钱

cards.Example: 明天或者后天都行。 míngtiān huòzhě hòutiān dōu xíng: Tomorrow or the day after both work.
cards.Notes: 或 vs 国: 国 puts 玉 in a box

cards.Example: 虽然很累,但是很开心。 suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì hěn kāixīn: I'm tired, but happy.
cards.Notes: 虽 = 口 + 虫 insect

cards.Example: 他已经走了。 tā yǐjīng zǒu le: He's already left.
cards.Notes: 已 / 己 / 巳: 已 is closed halfway up

cards.Example: 一直往前走。 yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu: Go straight ahead.
cards.Notes: 一 is yì before the 2nd-tone 直

cards.Example: 便宜,而且好吃。 piányi, érqiě hǎochī: Cheap, and tasty too.
cards.Notes: 且 vs 目: 且 has a long base line

cards.Example: 不错,不过有点贵。 búcuò, búguò yǒudiǎn guì: Not bad, but a bit pricey.
cards.Notes: 不 is bú before the 4th-tone 过

cards.Example: 她不但漂亮,而且聪明。 tā búdàn piàoliang, érqiě cōngming: She's not only pretty but smart too.
cards.Notes: Pairs with 而且; 不 is bú before 4th-tone 但

cards.Example: 只要你喜欢就好。 zhǐyào nǐ xǐhuan jiù hǎo: As long as you like it.
cards.Notes: 只 = 口 + 八

cards.Example: 要是下雨,我们就不去了。 yàoshi xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù bú qù le: If it rains, we won't go.
cards.Notes: More casual than 如果; usually followed by 就

cards.Example: 还有一件事。 háiyǒu yí jiàn shì: One more thing.
cards.Notes: 还 is hái here

cards.Example: 你先走吧。 nǐ xiān zǒu ba: You go first.
cards.Notes: Also the sound part of 洗 (xǐ, wash)

cards.Example: 最后他还是来了。 zuìhòu tā háishi lái le: In the end he came after all.
cards.Notes: 最 = 日 over 取 qǔ

cards.Example: 其实我不想去。 qíshí wǒ bù xiǎng qù: Actually, I don't want to go.
cards.Notes: 实 = 宀 roof + 头

cards.Example: 他一边吃饭一边看手机。 tā yìbiān chīfàn yìbiān kàn shǒujī: He looks at his phone while he eats.
cards.Notes: 一 is yì before the 1st-tone 边

cards.Example: 他十点才起床。 tā shí diǎn cái qǐchuáng: He didn't get up until ten.
cards.Notes: Looks like 扌 (hand) standing on its own

cards.Example: 你刚才说什么? nǐ gāngcái shuō shénme: What did you just say?
cards.Notes: 刚 = 冈 gāng + 刂 knife

cards.Example: 吃完饭以后给我打电话。 chī wán fàn yǐhòu gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà: Call me after you eat.
cards.Notes: 后 vs 右: 后 has a slanted roof

cards.Hanzi: 因为太累了,所以早睡了。
cards.Pinyin: yīnwèi tài lèi le, suǒyǐ zǎo shuì le
cards.Meaning: I was so tired, so I went to bed early.
cards.Notes: 因为 sets up the reason; 所以 gives the result

cards.Hanzi: 虽然很难,但是很有意思。
cards.Pinyin: suīrán hěn nán, dànshì hěn yǒu yìsi
cards.Notes: 虽然 warns you a 'but' is coming

cards.Hanzi: 如果明天不下雨,我们就去。
cards.Pinyin: rúguǒ míngtiān bú xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù qù
cards.Meaning: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we'll go.
cards.Notes: 如果 ... 就: the 就 marks the 'then' half
